name: fix-specs-risen-speed
about: Devil Forgemaster risen move at the chase pace at all times and attack what comes near, like the vanilla summons (the user, 2026-10-25: 'summoned bodies are moving at not aggroed speed ... they also dont attack enemies often'). Forgemaster_Risen.as HWPSpecsRisenUnit/HWPSpecsRisenStateUnit set every follower movement to roaming 1.0, speed >= 4.5 and run-back 1.4x, and the target search to half its cooldown (target-find-cooldown-mul 0.5, also in the generated unit). plan_forgemaster section risen_speed, every spot on a free lane from the start (gl terrain; 20261025-180859 teleported the priest into rock and spawned both brutes in rock, so nothing could path or see): the raise logs '[HWP:specs] risen N runs: ...', `hwp risen` reads the numbers, the risen closes in on a priest teleported down the lane (up to 260 px) within 1.5 s, and a brute down the lane, then one up the opposite lane (up to 150 px), is damaged within 5 s each; `hwp forge trace on` logs each risen's target and skills every 2 s meanwhile.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:specs\] risen \d+ runs: \S+ speed [0-9.]+ runback [0-9.]+ roaming 1\.0 search-mul 0\.5
